text: I moved to this city two years ago for work. At first it was hard for me. I did not know many people and my English was not very good. Every day I took the bus to my job and I came home in the evening. On weekends I stayed in my room and called my family. After some months I joined a running group near my house. The people there were kind and they helped me a lot. Now I run with them every Saturday morning. I am still learning English but I feel more happy here now.
